'''Milestones''' are a fast travel mechanic that allows the [[Keeper]] to travel to different [[locations]]. Travel is only possible between Milestones.

Each milestone must be activated using {{Item|Faith}}, after which it can be used indefinitely with no cooldown.

Activating a milestone contributes to the [[Milestone Hunter]] [[Inspirations|Inspiration]].
